name: FOLFIRI (Douillard)

source.textbook: DeVita, Hellman, and Rosenberg's Cancer: Principles & Practice of Oncology, 12th ed.
source.nccnTemplate: pending - per-disease NCCN Chemotherapy Order Template not yet provided

institution.provenance: textbook-grounded draft; NCCN per-disease template + clinical (StewardMD) + hospital/institutional approval pending

premedications.name: Antiemetic prophylaxis
premedications.notes: give before irinotecan per moderate emetic risk tier (appendix D)

supportiveCare: Antiemetics: moderate emetic risk tier (irinotecan IV, 30-90% frequency of emesis per NCCN appendix D categories); specific FOLFIRI per-day tier not printed in the provided appendix excerpt (no per-regimen table included) - verify against full NCCN Antiemesis guideline

G-CSF: febrile neutropenia risk level not printed for FOLFIRI in the provided appendix C excerpt (general risk-tier framework only, no per-regimen table) - commonly categorized intermediate risk in oncology practice; verify against NCCN Hematopoietic Growth Factors guideline before applying
Administration sequence per appendix F: irinotecan and leucovorin given concurrently (same line via Y-connector), followed by 5-FU bolus, followed by 5-FU 22-hr infusion, per source
monitoring: assess for diarrhea (irinotecan-associated) before each cycle

doseModificationRules.text: Review required. Protocol-specific delay/reduce criteria may apply; physician decides.

drugs.name: Irinotecan
drugs.notes: Douillard et al. 2000, DeVita 12th ed. line 123582/123587: 180 mg/m2 IV over 2 hr, day 1 only, concurrently with leucovorin (can be given in same line through Y connector).

drugs.name: Leucovorin
drugs.notes: DeVita 12th ed. line 123587-123588: 200 mg/m2 IV, concurrently with irinotecan on day 1; days 1 and 2 per source ("all other meds given days 1 and 2").

drugs.name: 5-Fluorouracil (bolus)
drugs.notes: DeVita 12th ed. line 123588: 400 mg/m2 IV bolus, days 1 and 2, given after irinotecan/leucovorin.

drugs.name: 5-Fluorouracil (infusion)
drugs.notes: DeVita 12th ed. line 123588: 600 mg/m2 IV infusion over 22 hr, days 1 and 2, given after the 5-FU bolus.
